newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiwa Sec says to buy back Y9 bln worth of shares.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa Sec says to buy back Y9 bln worth of shares.

text.p: Daiwa Securities Co Ltd said on Thursday it had decided to buy back a total of nine billion yen worth of its own shares.

The securities house, one of Japan's "Big Four" brokerages, said in a statement that it plans to buy a total 9.5 million of its own shares. The plan needs formal approval from an annual shareholders' meeting to be held on June 27, it said.

Of the total, six million shares, worth six billion yen, will be used for a stock option scheme the company is planning to introduce for its senior executives, it said. Stock options give holders the right to buy shares at a set price within a certain period.
